newsitem.title: USA: US March S&P 500 turns up after March bonds close.
newsitem.headline: US March S&P 500 turns up after March bonds close.

text.p: Feb 25 - US March S&P 500s turned up as March T-bonds closed, encouraged that the bond avoided new lows late, an S&P trader said. Buy-stops in March S&P hit at 810.00 and 812.00 to take market to new session high. Traders said locals best buyers, dealer participation light.
